text:
The plate is square and cut off at the top of the frame. It looks like a side or small dinner plate, about 22-24 cm across.

The roasted potato cubes cover roughly a 10x9 cm area and are about 2.5 cm high, in a loose pile. That comes to around 14 pieces at about 12 g each, so roughly 170 g.

The Brussels sprouts are about 10 whole or halved sprouts, partly cut off at the bottom edge. At about 12 g each, that is around 110 g.

The potatoes look lightly oiled, and the sprouts look glossy. The oil is absorbed into the food, so I am not counting it as a separate item.
